summary: A solid daily: everyone gets the big six, then Iran, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia and Canada make it a real test.
reasons: Casual player finds 8 quickly (China, US, India, Russia, Japan, Germany, Saudi Arabia, Canada) and then spends lives on UK, Brazil, Australia, France and South Korea.
Misses are near misses that teach something: South Korea is #11 by under 2 Mt, Brazil #13, the UK only #19.
Blitz works, but any country scores, so it plays like a country dump. Classic suits it better.

recheck.note: Re-checked Nov 17 (judged 2026-10-30: casual 8, fan 10). Page unchanged; 2023 is still its latest year. The rebuild brings "aus"/"oz" (Australia #16, they were free). Casual runs 10 and 8, so 9: the easiest of the fourteen (par.ts average 6.4, just over the 5 to 6 target). judgedAt predates the Nov 2 daily bar, so schedule.ts skips it unless re-judged.
recheck.decision: keep daily-list only as the easy day of its week, else swap it for a spare: the average lands just over 6
